summary: BTQ Technologies Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a Controlled Equity Offering Sales Agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald Co. and Cantor Fitzgerald Canada Corporation, dated June 18, 2026. Under the at-the-market (ATM) program, the company may issue and sell common shares through the agents for aggregate proceeds up to C$150 million. Shares will be sold under a Canadian final short form base shelf prospectus dated April 29, 2025, and a U.S. registration statement declared effective September 29, 2025. No specific price, premium, or board recommendation is provided. This is a routine capital-raising facility, not a special situation. What to watch: The actual pace and volume of share sales under the ATM, which may cause dilution.
